award.title: award
award.description: a named award, prize or honour

book.title: book
book.description: title of a book or novel

country.title: country
country.description: a country or nation state, including historical ones

event.title: event
event.description: a named event such as a war, festival, conference or ceremony

location.title: location
location.description: a geographic place that is not a country: city, region, province, river, mountain, constituency

misc.title: miscellaneous
misc.description: any other named entity that fits none of the types above, e.g. nationality, language, religion, named object or work

organisation.title: organisation
organisation.description: an organisation, company, agency, court, army or institution that fits no more specific type

person.title: person
person.description: a person who does not fit a more specific role type listed here

writer.title: writer
writer.description: a person known as an author, novelist, poet or playwright
